caption:
Surge Board profilingizda 🛹

Telegram NFT sovg‘asi Surge Board #3194 ni ijaraga oling: 3 kundan 30 kungacha profilingizda ko‘rinib turadi. Kuniga 850 so‘m, 30 kunga −7%.

Surge Board #3194: Fried Egg belgisi — atigi 0,5%, Shamrock Green fon 1,5%, Rune Nova modeli 2%.

Ijaraga olish: @ArendagaGiftBot — havola profilda.

#telegram #nft #telegramgifts #nftsovga #ijara #uzbekistan

concept.title: Levitatsiya
concept.hook: Birinchi kadr — och shalfey studiyasi, ulkan Surge Board magnit taglik ustida havoda suzib turibdi; tepada binafsha pill "Telegram NFT sovg‘a ijarasi" va "Kuniga / 850 so‘m" (binafsha, Lilita One 190 px); 0,3 s da taglik zaryadlanadi, binafsha va firuza maydon halqalari polga yoyiladi, taxta bir pog‘ona ko‘tariladi
concept.format: Zaryad pog‘onalari (yangi): har yangi qatorda taglik yana zaryadlanadi va taxta bir pog‘ona yuqoriga ko‘tariladi — "Surge Board / Fried Egg belgisi — atigi 0,5%", "Profilingizda turadi / 3 kundan 30 kungacha"; keyin narx, bot va havola
concept.why: Qamrov post boshiga ~100–140, like, saqlash, ulashish deyarli 0, obunachi 2; bitta post raqamlari shovqin. Eng yaxshi so‘nggi post (25a) 0-kadri yorqin, yuqori kontrastli edi; eng yomoni (25b) to‘q, naqshli fonda oltin gift — farq bor, lekin isbot emas. Shu sababli: yorug‘ fon, gift yagona yulduz, toza kontrast, 0-kadrda mahsulot va narx, kam so‘z, qulay sur’at. Katalogdagi yagona hech qachon ko‘rsatilmagan gift (#3194).
concept.differs: Ko‘rinish (och shalfey studiya, perspektiv pol to‘ri, magnit taglik, maydon halqalari — yangi; so‘nggi 4 ta to‘q fonli edi), palitra (shalfey + binafsha + o‘rmon siyohi, firuza faqat halqalarda), shrift (Lilita One — 18f dan beri birinchi marta — + Manrope), harakat (taxta pog‘onama-pog‘ona ko‘tariladi, sakrash yo‘q), musiqa (calm, D♭-major, 62 bpm, seed 359), yangi hover.wav tovushi, gift (Surge Board #3194 — birinchi marta)
